acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to repair a yard hydrant in the Las Vegas area varies depending on the specific issue, the type of hydrant, and the required parts. Minor repairs like replacing a packing washer are less expensive than major issues such as a broken standpipe or frost-proof valve. CG Plumbing Solutions provides upfront pricing after assessing the problem, ensuring transparency before any work begins.
